website.description: Opens a timed entry window, records one /random or /dice roll per player, then works out who asks and who answers. Highest roller sets the prompt, lowest takes it. Editable truth and dare lists feed !truth and !dare, plus jackpots, bonus prizes and settings profiles.
website.readmeExcerpt: # Truth or Dare Run Truth or Dare rounds at your venue without tracking rolls by hand. `Truth or Dare` is a Dalamud plugin that opens a timed entry window, records every player's roll, and works out who asks and who answers, with editable prompt lists, per-channel announcements, and saveable settings profiles. ## What It Does - **Open a timed entry window** of 60 seconds by default, with an automatic warning when time is nearly up. - **Record one roll per player** from `/random` or `/dice`, each independently toggleable, with later rolls from the same player discarded. - **Break ties by arrival order**, so whoever rolled the number first keeps it. - **Pick who asks and who answers** with six resolution modes: Highest asks lowest (the default), Highest roller, Lowest roller, Highest and lowest, Middle roller, and Random player. - **Gate entry behind `!join`** so rolls from an overlapping bingo or deathroll never land in your round. - **Draw from editable truth and dare lists** in two ratings, tame and spicy, with the last 15 prompts held back so the same line does not keep coming up. - **Keep the picks fresh** with no-repeat winners, pass-to-next for anyone who would rather sit one out, and an auto-skip list for regulars who never want to be chosen. - **Reward exact rolls** with a jackpot number, 666 by default, that overrides the normal result, plus bonus prizes on chosen numbers announced without affecting the round. - **Edit every announcement** as a template with placeholders, so the plugin says it in your venue's voice. - **Route each message type to its own chat channel**, including an optional per-winner channel. - **Name everyone at or under a threshold** with the optional forfeit list, off by default and set to 100. - **Save settings profiles** you can load, import, and export, so a host can move a setup between characters or venues. - **Survive a crash or reload**, as the live round is written to disk and picked back up where it left off. - **Track your rounds** with both session and all-time counters. ## How a Round Runs 1. The host starts a round, either from the plugin window or by typing `!tod` in chat. 2. The plugin announces the game and opens the entry window, 60 seconds by default. 3. Players enter with `/random`. If **Require join** is switched on, they must type `!join` first and any unrelated roll is ignored. 4. One roll is recorded per player. Later rolls from the same player are discarded. 5. With 10 seconds left, the plugin posts a warning. 6. When the window closes, the lowest roller picks truth or dare and the highest roller sets the question or the dare. 7. If nobody can think of anything, either picked player can type `!truth` or `!dare` to draw a random prompt from the plugin's list. ## Commands - `/tod` - Open the main plugin window. - `/tod config` - Open directly to the settings section. - `/todstart` - Start a round. - `/todstop` - Cancel the round in progress. - `/todstatus` - Print the current round state to your own chat log. ## Chat Triggers - `!tod` - Start a round. Restricted to the host by default. - `!join` - Register for the round, used when **Require join** is switched on. Anyone can use it. - `!truth` - Draw a random truth prompt. Available to the players the round picked. - `!dare` - Draw a random dare prompt. Available to the players the round picked. The `!` prefix is configurable, and you choose which chat channels the plugin listens to. By default it watches Say, Shout, and Yell. ## Interface ### Guide A walkthrough of how a round runs, the slash commands, and the chat triggers, so a new host can get going without leaving the game. ![Guide Tab](Images/Screenshots/guide.png) ### Round Start, watch, and resolve a round. Shows the live entry countdown, the roll list as it fills, and the resolved result with controls to reroll the prompt, pass to the next player, or cancel outright. ![Round Tab](Images/Screenshots/round.png) ### Prompts Edit the truth and dare lists. Covers the prompts that ship with the plugin and your own additions, filtered by kind and by rating. Shipped prompts can be hidden rather than deleted, so your choices survive future updates to the list. ![Prompts Tab](Images/Screenshots/prompts.png) ### Profiles Save, load, and delete named settings profiles. Each profile carries the full game settings and prompt list, and can be moved between characters with the clipboard import and export buttons. ![Profiles Tab](Images/Screenshots/profiles.png) ### Settings Manage the plugin from the **Settings** sidebar group, split into **Game**, **Chat Channels**, **Announcements**, **Extras**, and **UI**. #### Game Set the entry window and its warning, the minimum number of players, how players enter, and how the round resolves. The resolution controls also appear on the Round tab, so you can switch modes mid-session without leaving the round. ![Game Settings](Images/Screenshots/game-settings.png) #### Chat Channels Choose where each kind of message is posted, from rules and countdowns through to results, prompts, jackpots, and bonus prizes. Also sets which channels chat triggers are accepted from. ![Chat Channel Settings](Images/Screenshots/chat-channels-settings.png) #### Announcements Every line the plugin says, as an editable template, with a placeholder reference for each one. ![Announcement Settings](Images/Screenshots/announcements-settings.png) #### Extras The optional additions: the jackpot roll, bonus prizes on chosen numbers, the auto-skip list, and the forfeit list. ![Extras Settings](Images/Screenshots/extras-settings.png) #### UI Pick the two theme colours that every other colour in the window is derived from. ![UI Settings](Images/Screenshots/ui-settings.png) ### Support Read common questions and follow the Discord link for support specific to Truth or Dare. ![Support Tab](Images/Screenshots/support.png) ## How to Install Truth or Dare 1. Type `/xlsettings` in the in-game chat. 2. Go to the Experimental tab. 3. Paste this link into the **Custom Plugin Repositories** at the bottom: `https://puni.sh/api/repository/oof-games` 4. Click the `+` button, ensure it is **Enabled**, and click **Save and Close**. 5. Type `/xlplugins`, search for "Truth or Dare", and click **Install**. ## Want to run Truth or Dare at your venue? Join the [OOFGames Discord](https://discord.gg/vM6ff4h5Ym) and we'll get you set up! ## Credits The round logic in this plugin is derived from **[OpenToD](https://github.com/kirin-xiv/OpenToD) by Kirin Avenleigh**, released under the MIT licence and left unmaintained and open for others to build on. Roll capture, tiebreak ordering, the winner selection modes, jackpot and bonus prizes, the auto-skip list, pass-to-next, announcement templating, per-channel output, and settings profiles all originate there. Thanks to Kirin for putting it out for others to carry on. Added here: the chat trigger layer (`!tod`, `!join`, `!truth`, `!dare`), the timed entry window with its warning, join gating, the prompt library, and the interface. Chat sending uses [ECommons](https://github.com/NightmareXIV/ECommons) by NightmareXIV. ## Licence Truth or Dare is licensed AGPL-3.0-or-later. See [LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md), and [THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md](THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md) for the licences of the work it builds on.
